auth.title: Xiaomi Account Login
auth.description:
Please login to your Xiaomi account:

1. Open this URL in your browser:
{auth_url}

2. Login with your Xiaomi account

3. After authorization, you will be redirected to a URL like:
`https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth?code=xxx&state=yyy`

4. Copy the `code` and `state` values from the URL and enter them below.
